_doc: Optional alternate search keywords per theme. Used by build_theme_lineage.py to UNION additional canonical-name variants into the seed pool (#274 — was: "fallback when primary returns 0", which missed cases like "Flash Attention" vs the one-word "FlashAttention" canonical paper). Aliases are merged in parallel with the primary keyword, then the unified pool is re-ranked by citation count and capped at seeds_count. Keys are lower-cased theme strings (the same normalisation discover_seeds applies internally). `_topic_terms` (R2-2b, design doc 40) is NOT searched: lower-cased theme -> extra phrases that also count as 'about this theme' for the topic scope (apps/pipeline/src/lineage/theme/topicScope.ts: seed role, root choice, BFS admission gate). The theme itself, its aliases, plural/space-less forms and a 3+ letter initialism are always included.
